items.title: Cognizant brings Claude to 350,000 employees
items.summary: Cognizant will deploy Claude across its global workforce to accelerate enterprise AI adoption, legacy modernization, and agent orchestration.
items.summaryZh: 本文来自Anthropic News，围绕“Cognizant brings Claude to 350,000 employees”介绍行业落地方面的最新进展，重点涉及Claude、Agent、行业应用。下方为系统保存的原文正文。

items.title: Commitments on model deprecation and preservation
items.summary: Anthropic commits to preserving the weights of all publicly released Claude models and interviewing retiring models about their preferences.
